headline: Mettler-Toledo International (NYSE:MTD) Beats Q2 Earnings, Raises Full-Year Guidance
summary: Mettler-Toledo beat Q2 earnings estimates, raised full-year guidance, and saw shares rise 2.9% after-hours on strong profit performance.
